data.title: Second reminder: dental invoice €417.80
data.summary: Muster Abrechnungszentrum für Zahnärzte GmbH, billing on behalf of Dr. Beispielhaus's dental practice, sends a second reminder (2. Mahnung) dated 7 August 2026. €417.80 is open (invoice €412.80 plus €5.00 reminder fee), payable by 21 August 2026.
data.explanation: This is a second payment reminder for a dental treatment on 18 May 2026. You did not react to the invoice of 2 June or the reminder of 10 July. Pay €417.80 by 21 August 2026 to the account shown, using the invoice number as reference. If you disagree with the invoice, the letter asks you to call them before the due date. If you have already paid, contact them. Unpaid bills can lead to further costs, so act soon.

items.title: Pay open dental invoice
items.action: Pay €417.80 (invoice €412.80 plus €5.00 reminder fee) to the account stated. If you dispute the invoice, call the billing centre first.

data.tax_note: Dental costs may be deductible as extraordinary medical expenses (außergewöhnliche Belastungen); keep the invoice and proof of payment.
